notes.content:
Added control using a gamepad.
The configuration of the buttons cannot be changed, but can be viewed in the settings.

-5 new signs of sleep. 4 basic, 1 additional. 3 of them were taken from the players ' offers (added to the credits: Amievil, Oybek, BOT Bob)
-4 new achievements. It's like a meeting with a note and a safe. We should have introduced them earlier. But I am sure that those who performed the necessary actions will be able to repeat them without problems)
- Minor edits.

Changes made:
"Dream encounters are looped. After the last one comes the first one again
-All notes are enough to find 1 time. They can be found again in new sessions, but this will not affect the ability to "exit"
- Added the probability of 604 additional signs of sleep (I look at the achievements - it almost does not fly out)
- Error correction.
